jobs.title: Seed Supply Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**Location:** South San Francisco, CA

**Type:** Full-time

**Reports to:** VP, Global Production & Supply

**The Opportunity:**

Ohalo is seeking an agentic AI-capable, hands-on, first-principles leader to plan and manage seed production and supply as the company scales. This person will connect production, R&D, Commercial, and customer delivery around one reliable view of what we expect to produce, what is available to commit, and when customers can receive it.  
  
This is a build role. The Seed Supply Operations Lead will establish the processes, data, systems, and decision rules that connect bioreactor output through seed delivery. The goal is a planning capability that detects changes early, evaluates feasible responses, automates repeatable work, and gives people clear choices when judgment is required. We want someone who can use AI where it improves speed or decision quality, and can demonstrate when a simpler approach works better.  
  
The role has high visibility with Ohalo's leadership team. Its success will be measured by better supply decisions and more reliable customer commitments, not by the number of meetings, dashboards, or AI tools introduced.

**Responsibilities:**

* **An integrated supply picture:** Build a planning model that connects demand, production capacity, expected yield, batch timing, quality status, usable inventory, logistics, and customer commitments. Make uncertainty visible rather than presenting a single forecast as a certainty.
* **The planning operating model:** Establish practical short-, medium-, and long-range planning and decision processes. This may include S&OE and S&OP disciplines, but you will design the cadence around the decisions Ohalo needs to make, rather than inherit a standard meeting structure.
* **Supply and customer commitment decisions:** Create a dependable view of available and projected supply, including the assumptions and release gates behind it. Identify shortages and competing demands early; present allocation and recovery options with their customer and operational consequences. Work with the VP, Global Production & Supply Chain, and Commercial leadership to define who recommends, approves, and communicates consequential commitments and allocation decisions.
* **Scenario planning:** Model the effect of changes in demand, yield, capacity, batch timing, quality release, and logistics. Show leaders the feasible options, trade-offs, and time available to act.
* **AI-enabled workflows:** Identify and deploy specific uses of AI, machine learning, and automation across forecasting, exception detection, scenario analysis, and planning coordination. Define the data, rules, approval points, and performance measures for each use case. Keep people accountable for decisions that require commercial, technical, or operational judgment.
* **Data and systems:** Define the planning data model and the flow of information from source systems into decisions. Partner with technology and functional leaders to select and implement appropriate tools, including APS (Advanced Planning Scheduling), ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), or demand-planning capabilities where justified. Build a foundation that can evolve with Ohalo rather than assuming one system will solve the planning problem.
* **Exceptions and execution:** Establish a clear way to detect, prioritize, assign, and resolve issues such as supply shortfalls, demand changes, batch delays, and quality holds before they become customer-facing problems.
* **Cross-functional alignment:** Bring Production & Supply, R&D, and Commercial together around shared assumptions, a coherent plan, and explicit decisions. Make disagreements and trade-offs visible so leaders can resolve them promptly.
* **Planning performance:** Define and review measures such as forecast accuracy and bias, supply reliability, performance against committed delivery dates, inventory exposure, and exception resolution time. Use the initial operating period to establish baselines and set improvement targets.
* **Capability building:** Develop the processes, documentation, skills, and team structure needed for planning to scale from pilots to commercial volumes.

  

**Candidate Profile**

* Significant experience in supply, demand, production, or integrated planning, including responsibility for improving a planning process across functions. We value demonstrated ability to build and change an operating model more than years spent running an established one.
* Evidence of designing and deploying a data-driven or AI-enabled operational workflow that changed how decisions were made. You can explain the problem, the data and tools used, what was automated or supported, how people adopted it, and what results were achieved.
* Strong understanding of capacity, inventory, demand, and service trade-offs. Able to translate uncertain production outcomes into realistic plans and commitments.
* Comfortable working with biological or process variability, including yield uncertainty, batch timing, and quality release gates.
* Strong systems and data fluency. Able to work from source data through planning logic to operational decisions, and to partner effectively with technical teams.
* Excellent cross-functional leadership. Able to align Production, R&D, and Commercial stakeholders, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive decisions without relying solely on formal authority.
* Comfortable building in an early-stage, fast-moving company. Willing to work directly with data and processes while developing a capability that others can operate and improve.
* Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, a quantitative discipline, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

**Desired Skills/Experience**

* Experience in agribusiness, seed production, biotechnology, biomanufacturing, or another supply chain with uncertain yields and quality release requirements.
* Experience designing AI agents, copilo

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description:
**Office Manager**

* **Location:** San Francisco, CA — Onsite, 5 days/week
* **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:00 PM
* **Employment Type:** Full-Time, Non-Exempt
* **Compensation:** $28–35/hour, depending on experience
* **Reports To:** Dr. Benjamin Kruman
* **Desired Start Date:** ASAP

**About The Orofacial Pain Specialty Group**

The (the OPS Group, for short) is a new specialty practice in San Francisco dedicated to providing thoughtful, comprehensive care to patients experiencing complex orofacial pain conditions—TMJ disorders, chronic headaches and migraines, sleep apnea, and related conditions that too often go misdiagnosed or dismissed elsewhere.

The practice is led by , DDS DABOP, a board-certified orofacial pain specialist and Assistant Clinical Professor at UCSF School of Dentistry.

We're built around a simple idea: patients dealing with complex orofacial pain deserve private, unhurried, evidence-based care—especially the ones who haven't found relief anywhere else. That means real time for diagnosis, conservative treatment planning, and a practice that never feels rushed. The Office Manager sets that tone before a patient even sits down in the chair.

We're at the very beginning: a new office, a new team, and a lot still to build.

**About the Role**

The Office Manager is the person who makes the practice run — the first voice a patient hears on the phone, the first face they see when they walk in, and the person keeping everything else on track behind the scenes.

Our practice is built on four values—compassion, communication, innovation, and education—and the Office Manager brings them to life before a patient ever sits down in the chair. Compassion means genuine warmth for people who are often anxious or in pain. Communication means being clear and responsive with both patients and the team. Innovation means helping us build better systems as a brand-new practice figures out how it wants to run. And education means constantly learning—new tools, new processes, better ways to take care of people.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll move fluidly between greeting patients, managing the schedule, ordering supplies, coordinating vendors, and building the systems and processes the practice doesn't have yet because it's brand new. You'll work directly with Dr. Kruman and have real input into how the practice runs day to day—not just executing someone else's playbook, but helping write it.

**We're looking for someone who takes ownership without waiting to be asked.** You'll rarely be told exactly how to do something—you'll be trusted to figure it out, ask good questions when you need to, and follow through. If you notice something's off, you fix it or flag it. That instinct matters more to us than having every process memorized on day one.

**What You'll Do:**

**Patient Experience & Front Desk**

* Welcome patients and create a warm, professional, comfortable experience from the moment they arrive.
* Manage check-in/check-out and keep the front desk organized.
* Schedule and coordinate appointments, follow-ups, and referrals in AthenaHealth.
* Answer phones and respond to patient inquiries clearly and professionally across phone, email, and other channels.
* Maintain a calm, welcoming environment for patients who may be dealing with pain, anxiety, or uncertainty—and protect their privacy and confidentiality at all times.

**Office Operations & Practice Support**

* Own the day-to-day administrative operations of the practice—supplies, vendors, building management, maintenance, deliveries, and general facilities needs.
* Maintain organized files, records, and documentation; support basic financial processes like invoices, payments, and expense tracking.
* Serve as a trusted operational partner to Dr. Kruman—anticipate needs, coordinate his calendar, and solve problems before they become bigger ones.
* Help implement new tools, systems, and processes as the practice grows, and look for ways to improve how things run.
* Assist with onboarding new vendors, partners, and (eventually) team members.
* Build relationships with patients, referring providers, vendors, and the local community—and represent the practice well while doing it.
* Help plan and host occasional events for the practice, its partners, and its patients.

**Who You Are**

You're **warm, capable, organized, and proactive** — the kind of person who notices what needs to happen next and takes it on without being asked twice.

**Requirements**

* 2–3+ years of experience in a role with real people-facing responsibility and operational ownership—healthcare, dental, hospitality, or another high-touch professional services environment
* Front-desk, office administration, or practice coordination experience—or something close enough that the transition is short
* Exceptional organizational skills; you don't let details slip
* Clear, warm communication, in writing and in person
* Real discretion handling sensitive, confidential information
* Ability to hold multiple priorities at once without losing your calm
* Follow-through—you do what you say you're going to do, every time

jobs.title: Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Do you want to help run a Y-Combinator-backed AI startup from the inside, reporting to the COO and working directly with the entire leadership team? Do you thrive on creating order, and do you love a role where every day looks different? If you want autonomy, room to run, and a clear path to a Chief of Staff role, all at the cutting edge of AI technology in financial services, then read on!

**Who are we?**
---------------

Veritus was born from a simple belief: the conversations between lenders and their customers deserve better technology. We build AI agents that talk with borrowers by voice, text, email, and chat, from the first loan application through the final payment. Our platform is built for lenders, card issuers, and collection agencies who want to transform their operations with AI. Backed by Y Combinator, Crosslink, and Threshold, our AI agents already handle thousands of conversations every day.

We're looking for an Operations Associate who wants to learn how an early-stage startup actually runs by helping run it, and are seeking someone who thrives at the intersection of organization, execution, and AI.

**What will the Operations Associate do?**
------------------------------------------

The Operations Associate keeps Veritus running: the San Francisco office, the leadership team's operating cadence, and the cross-functional projects our COO needs done, so that routine work runs on schedule and every important item gets done.

Reporting directly to our COO, Kasia Gora, you will split your time roughly evenly between running our San Francisco office and owning operational projects for the COO. From the Monday leadership meeting to the holiday party, you will manage meeting materials, OKR tracking, vendors and budgets, interview scheduling, new hire setup, team events, and business travel. You'll work with the COO every day and with the whole leadership team, and there is a clear path to Chief of Staff for the right person.

**Who will love this job?**
---------------------------

* You thrive when you can drive high impact across a whole company, and you bring the same care to every task, big or small. You're energized by learning how an early-stage startup actually runs by helping run it.
* You are relentlessly positive and view yourself as a pillar of company culture, and you get excited by all the possibilities to shape it through your work and interactions.
* You enjoy working in an entrepreneurial, AI-first environment where AI tools are the first thing you reach for.
* You are an execution expert: you keep dozens of open items on track with trackers and checklists, and you finish each one on your own, so the COO only has to ask once.
* You feel at home working with people inside and outside the company: you coordinate schedules across the leadership team, candidates, and interviewers, and you follow up with vendors and procurement teams until you have what you need. You take pride in how you show up, knowing that you are a beacon of Veritus’ values and culture!
* You communicate with precision: your updates, follow-ups, and SOPs are concise, accurate, and polished, so leaders can act on them right away.
* You take pride in building repeatable processes: you like turning a manual workflow into a documented, AI-assisted process that someone else could run.
* You are a scrappy, relentless problem-solver who figures things out and writes the playbook as you go, and who measures success by outcomes: action items closed, materials ready on deadline, and an office that runs smoothly because you run it.
* You want your work to matter and you want to work with folks who both laugh and get things done. You bring rigor as well as a sense of humor!

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Leadership Operations**

* Run the leadership team's operating cadence: schedule leadership meetings and offsites, track OKRs, and follow up on action items until they close.
* Prepare recurring company materials, including weekly All Hands slides and KPI reporting, ready by the deadline every week.
* Take special projects off the COO's plate and run them end to end.

**Office Management and Events Planning**

* Run the San Francisco office: snacks and supplies, packages and shipping, vendors, mail, guests, facilities, and the office budget.
* Schedule and support company offsites, internal team events, and business events, on budget and on time.
* Coordinate business travel for the team.

**Hiring and Onboarding**

* Schedule all candidate interviews promptly as candidates advance.
* Get every new hire's desk, office access, welcome basket, and first-week schedule ready for day one, using a checklist you build and maintain.

**Finance and Processes**

* Assist with invoicing, accounts receivable follow-up, budgets, and expense tracking.
* Turn repetitive workflows into documented, AI-assisted processes that someone else could run.
* Jump on new and unexpected tasks as they come up.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

Our ideal candidate...

* …has experience in an operations, office management, project coordination, or similar organizational role.
* …is smart and quick to learn, with a strong work ethic and a deep sense of ownership.
* …is eloquent in writing and in person: concise, accurate, and polished.
* …is incredibly organized, with meticulous attention to detail.
* …is humble, eager to learn, and ready to grow with the company.
* …takes on every task, from leadership meeting prep to restocking the snacks, with the same care.
* …is positive, has a sense of humor, and has a vision for a company culture they feel passionate about fostering.
* …uses AI tools every day, and using AI is as second nature as using Google Workspace and Slack.
* …has experience in any of the following: an early-stage startup, in vendor or facilities management, AI agents or no-code automations, or in fintech or another regulated industry.

jobs.title: Merchant Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**Remote.** Open to candidates in Canada or in the following US states: Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Vermont, and Virginia (excluding the New York City, Boston, Philadelphia, and Washington DC metro areas).

### **Who Are We?**

Thanx is a leading loyalty and guest engagement platform for regional and national restaurants. We help brands drive profitable growth by increasing guest frequency, growing digital sales, and reducing reliance on discounts. Most loyalty platforms work for guests who are already loyal. Thanx unifies loyalty, digital ordering, and marketing automation in one platform that turns first-time and casual guests into regulars, treating loyalty as a business outcome, not a program, and engaging across the entire guest base.

Thanx has raised more than $30M from elite investors including M33 Growth, Ribbit Capital, and Sequoia Capital. Our success is rooted in a culture that has attracted some of the best talent in the country, and we are proud of strong employee tenure, a track record of internal promotions, and the company-wide shift to working AI-native over the last 18 months. We credit our cultural "core behaviors" with these accomplishments: Think Boldly, Execute Reliably, Focus on What Matters, Say "Thanx" Genuinely, Encourage Diverse Perspectives, and Lead, Virtually.

### **Who Are You?**

You like figuring out why something broke. A reward didn't apply, a location stopped sending transactions, an order failed. You keep digging until you have an answer you can back up with data.

You're comfortable with technical tools and you pick up new systems quickly. You may not have worked with restaurant POS systems or payments before, and that's fine. You can explain what you found to a merchant or a teammate who doesn't know the technical details.

You already use AI in your daily work, and you want to be somewhere that expects it.

Everyone at Thanx has equity and is expected to operate like an owner. That means real intensity, including evenings and weekends when the work calls for it. If that isn't what you're looking for right now, this isn't the right role. We would rather you know that before you apply than after you start.

### **Position Overview**

Merchant Operations makes sure our restaurant partners' setup works: their loyalty programs, mobile apps, online ordering, and the POS and other integrations behind them. We work closely with the Implementation team to launch merchants, then with Customer Success to make sure the program keeps operating effectively. Our part is the technical configuration, and after launch we monitor location health, investigate issues, and get root causes fixed.

You'll report to the Director of Merchant Operations and Support and work day to day with Support, Customer Success, Implementation, Product, and Engineering. You'll own a real piece of the work from your first months, not a narrow ticket queue.

### **How We Work With AI**

"With great power comes great responsibility." Uncle Ben

AI has changed what a day on this team looks like. Investigating an issue used to mean pulling data from several systems by hand. Now an agent can gather the evidence, and your time goes to figuring out what it means. We build our own monitors, lookups, and triage tools, and we expect everyone on the team to build, not just use them.

These tools are wrong often enough that you have to check the numbers and question the first explanation before anything reaches a merchant or a colleague. That part is still your job.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Configure merchant setups.** Set up and update loyalty, rewards, app, and online ordering for new and existing merchants. This is a high-volume part of the job, so accuracy and speed both matter.
* **Connect partner integrations.** Link merchants to their POS, ordering, and delivery partners, handle credentials, and work with partner teams when something needs their side.
* **Investigate and resolve issues.** Take escalations from Support and Customer Success, work out what is actually happening, and either fix it or give Engineering a clear bug report with the evidence.
* **Monitor location health.** Catch locations that go quiet, integrations that break, and cards that stop transacting before merchants report them.
* **Manage card network enrollment.** Enroll locations with Visa, Mastercard, and Amex, and troubleshoot when transactions don't flow the way they should.
* **Build and improve automations.** Turn repetitive manual work into monitors, lookups, and workflows the whole team can use.
* **Communicate clearly.** Write updates for merchants and teammates that people can act on without a follow-up question.

### **How We Will Know It's Working**

At six months, you're handling the team's core configuration and investigation work on your own, your diagnoses hold up when Engineering reviews them, and you've shipped at least one automation the team uses.

At twelve months, you own an area end to end, such as an integration, a card network, or a monitoring area, and you've made a visible difference in how the team works.

### **What We're Looking For**

We don't believe in rigid requirements, but success in this role typically involves:

* Experience in a technical support, operations, implementation, or similar role where you diagnosed problems across multiple systems.
* A track record of finding root causes, not just closing tickets.
* Comfort with data. SQL is a big plus, and we'll teach what you need if you have the aptitude.
* Experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to speed up analysis, troubleshooting, or workflows.
* Clear written communication with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* A habit of automating repetitive work when you see it.
* Comfort in a lean, fast-moving environment where priorities shift.
* Experience with restaur

jobs.title: Digital Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Nerdio**

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.

We support organizations of all sizes looking to deploy, manage, and cost-optimize native Microsoft technologies. We partner with Enterprises and Managed Service Providers all over the world to add value on top of their existing native Microsoft investments like Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune.

Created in 2016, Nerdio has always taken a market-leading and collaborative approach to cloud deployment and management. In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology.

Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

**About the role**

Nerdio is hiring a Digital Program Manager to orchestrate the scaled customer experience across Customer Success. You will own the automated journeys end to end, and act as an internal consultant to the rest of the CS organization: finding friction in the customer journey and removing it with automation and agentic AI.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Digital Customer Success and work alongside the Pooled CS team, but your reach is wider: the plays you build are designed for reuse across Customer Success, so customers get one seamless experience no matter who owns the moment. This is a builder role with no named book of business. You bring the ownership and customer-first urgency of a CAM or TAM to cross-functional programs, and you are comfortable bringing structure to ambiguity.

**What you'll do**

**Orchestrate the scaled customer experience**

* Own the digital journey from onboarding through adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion readiness. Build, launch, monitor, and iterate the plays and automations at each stage.
* Build the triggers and handoffs that bring in a CAM or TAM at the right moment (health thresholds, renewal risk, expansion signals, escalations, champion changes, customer requests), following the coverage model set by the strategy lead.
* Deliver against the current and future-state journey maps owned by the strategy lead. Surface the friction points you find in the data and in the field, and close them so the experience feels the same regardless of who owns the moment.

**Act as an internal consultant to Customer Success**

* Lead discovery with CS teams: ticket analysis, stakeholder interviews, and data review to find where manual, repetitive, or inconsistent work hurts customers or burns CAM/TAM capacity.
* Recommend and build the fix: automation, signal-based triggers, and agentic AI. Give teams plays they can turn on today.

**Lead agentic AI and automation**

* Move the program from static plays to adaptive, agentic journeys for higher-complexity moments, such as personalized onboarding and automated EBR/TVR one-pagers.
* Equip CAMs and TAMs with agentic insights that make their jobs easier and return capacity to them.
* Evaluate tools, run pilots, and set guardrails so AI-driven touches are accurate, on-brand, and hand off to a human when one is needed.

**Run the program and the partnerships**

* Own program and project management from discovery to launch to iteration: scope, plan, sequence, and keep a current view of the roadmap, status, and dependencies.
* Partner with Marketing on every lifecycle communication, RevOps on segmentation and metrics, Product on telemetry and in-app messaging, Support on ticket signals, and Sales on expansion.
* Prove impact. Tie each play to NRR, adoption, and risk reduction, run test-and-learn cycles, and share results broadly.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in digital customer success, lifecycle or adoption marketing, CS operations, or program management for a scaled customer segment.
* A track record of leading cross-functional programs from idea to launch and influencing partners without direct authority.
* A consultative approach: you can run discovery, facilitate working sessions, and turn what you hear into a prioritized plan.
* Hands-on experience with CS, marketing automation, or CRM platforms, and the ability to build or configure automated journeys.
* Practical experience with, or strong curiosity about, AI agents and LLM-based workflows, and sound judgment on where AI should and should not act.
* Data fluency: you use product telemetry, health scores, and attribution to choose what to build and show what worked.
* Strong prioritization, risk management, and written and verbal communication for audiences from CAMs to executives.
* A builder mentality and comfort with ambiguity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in B2B SaaS, cloud, or the Microsoft and MSP ecosystem.
* Experience with Partner Success or Support operations.
* Hands-on use of no-code or low-code agent builders and prompt design.

**Benefits and Incentives**

* Competitive Base and Incentive Plan
* Stock Options
* Health and Welfare Plans\*
* Life and Disability Plans\*
* Retirement Plan\*
* Unlimited Flexible Paid Time Off, including your birthday off!
* Collaborative Team Culture
* Benefits for international employees, outside the US, vary by country.

Nerdio is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Nerdio is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age

This position primarily conducts outbound and inbound telephone outreach to educate stakeholders, guide them through the enrollment process, resolve questions, and ensure all enrollment requirements are completed accurately and timely.

* Provide training and guidance to clients on the use of EVV and Facility platforms, tools, and processes.
* Gather required information from claimants and caregivers and accurately record data in Wellcove’s platforms/systems.

* Provide outstanding customer service via phone and email, displaying professionalism, empathy, a sense of urgency, and a genuine willingness to help.

* Accountable and able to work remotely and independently.
* Displays a positive ‘can do’/customer-first attitude.
* Ability to accurately document customer responses while simultaneously speaking with customers.
* Excellent communication skills and appropriate etiquette, great phone manners, and ability to speak with a wide range of personalities. Demonstrate a high level of proficiency in the use of the English language in oral and written forms.
* Collaborative team spirit.
* Ability to explain complex processes in a clear and easy-to-understand manner.

* Ability to meet performance metrics related to call volume, quality, and enrollment activation.

jobs.title: Sr. Security Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

#### **The Role**

We are currently seeking a Sr. Manager, Security Operations to lead our Global Security Operations team within Addepar's Information Security & Risk organization. In this role, you will own the day-to-day running of our detection and response function, act as incident commander for security incidents, and partner with our 24/7 MSSP to ensure threats are identified and handled quickly. You will set the operational objectives and strategy for Security Operations, lead and grow a global team, and shape our detection strategy for threats specific to Addepar's environment. Beyond the immediate response, you will make sure we learn from every incident by driving post-incident follow-through, turning incident trends into lasting fixes with partners across the business, and reporting on the health of the program to Security leadership. We also want this leader to modernize how Security Operations works, applying AI and automation (AIOps) to speed up triage, investigation and response so the team can focus on the highest-impact work. The successful candidate is a hands-on leader who brings structure, calm and accountability to high-pressure situations.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

#### **What You'll Do**

* **Operational Leadership:** Lead the day-to-day operations of Addepar's Global Security Operations team, and serve as incident commander for major security incidents
* **People Management:** Manage and develop a globally distributed team. Provide mentorship and training, set the team's roadmap and OKRs, and manage on-call coverage across time zones
* **MSSP Partnership:** Own the relationship with our 24/7 Managed Security Services Provider (MSSP), including escalation paths, service quality, vendor performance and cost, and handoffs to the internal team
* **Detection & SIEM:** Own our detection strategy and the health of our SIEM environment. This includes building custom detections for threats unique to Addepar, tuning alerts to improve fidelity and reduce noise, expanding log source coverage, and ensuring the platform scales as Addepar grows
* **AI-Driven Modernization:** Lead the modernization of our SecOps function through AIOps, using AI and automation to streamline alert triage, enrichment, investigation and response, reduce manual toil, and scale the team's impact
* **Documentation & Playbooks:** Build and own our incident response documentation, including playbooks, runbooks and training materials, and keep it current as threats and our environment evolve
* **Post-Incident Accountability:** Maintain our post-incident process so action items are clearly owned, tracked and closed across teams, covering both immediate fixes and longer-term improvements
* **Root Cause Remediation:** Use incident trends to identify recurring root causes, and partner with Engineering, Infrastructure, Security and Product teams to prioritize and deliver preventive fixes
* **Metrics, KPIs & Reporting:** Define and track key SecOps metrics and KPIs, and present a holistic monthly view of the Security Operations function to senior leadership
* **Security Awareness:** Champion security awareness across the company through tabletop exercises, training sessions and talks
* **On-Call:** Participate in a global on-call rotation, including responding to critical security events outside of standard working hours

#### **Who You Are**

You will bring organisation, clarity, and momentum to conservation projects across multiple institutions, working closely with NARA’s project team and library contacts. In 2016, we launched **Conductor Power** to compete harder, move faster, and step boldly into renewable energy. From substations to solar EPC projects, our work is critical, complex, and built to last.

  

**Job Summary:**

The **High Voltage Substation Project Manager** is responsible for managing substation and associated high voltage scopes supporting utility-scale solar and battery energy storage projects. This position oversees planning, engineering coordination, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, and closeout while maintaining accountability for safety, quality, schedule, budget, and client satisfaction. The Project Manager coordinates internal teams, subcontractors, suppliers, clients, and interconnecting utilities to deliver reliable facilities that meet contractual and utility requirements.

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

Provides leadership and oversight to assigned project personnel, which may include Assistant Project Managers, Project Engineers, Field Engineers, and project support staff. Coordinates with Substation Superintendents, field leadership, and subcontractors to establish priorities, manage resources, and maintain accountability for execution. **Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain execution plans, budgets, schedules, staffing plans, and procurement strategies aligned with contractual milestones.
* Manage sitework, foundations, grounding, steel structures, electrical equipment, buswork, control buildings, cabling, and protection and control scopes.
* Coordinate interfaces between the substation, medium voltage collection system, generation tie line, and utility point of interconnection.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to review drawings, specifications, submittals, and constructability concerns; manage RFIs and design changes through resolution.
* Coordinate procurement, delivery, receiving, and installation of long-lead equipment, including transformers, breakers, switches, and control equipment.

* Coordinate outages, utility witness testing, energization readiness, and approved switching activities with authorized utility and commissioning personnel.
* Identify risks, including equipment delays, design conflicts, and utility dependencies; develop mitigation and recovery plans.

* Capture lessons learned and support improvements to project execution processes.

* All other duties as assigned or delegated.

* Medical insurance
* 401(k) with employer match
* Life, AD&D insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Paid Time Off

  

**Required Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Strong understanding of high voltage substation construction methods, sequencing, equipment, and installation requirements.
* Working knowledge of transformers, breakers, switches, grounding, buswork, protection and control systems, and SCADA.
* Ability to interpret one-line diagrams, electrical schematics, civil and structural drawings, specifications, and contracts.

Lydian is an established energy development company specializing in the development and construction of utility-scale solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects in North America. jobs.title: Program Manager, Executive Development
jobs.description:
People Development accelerates the performance of every Metamate, team, and leader — building the capabilities, culture, and human-AI partnerships that power Meta's future. We help people thrive through continuous change, grow more valuable over time, and choose to stay. We do this through coaching, team development, leadership experiences, performance systems, and skills at scale — all working as an integrated system, not a set of disconnected programs.This individual contributor role sits on the Executive Development team, which delivers best-in-class development to Meta's senior most leaders as they forge the future at a transformational moment in the company's history. You will be responsible for the delivery, execution and operations of Executive Development experiences, ensuring the work we do addresses real needs, is targeted, and makes a real difference to our leaders and the business.  
  
  

### **Program Manager, Executive Development Responsibilities:**

* Own the delivery of Executive Development programs. Serve as the participant-facing program manager once a cohort is running, including in-session presence, cohort communications, and holding the experience standard live.
* Own in-person and virtual event execution: venues, vendors, production, print and delivery, and day-of execution — so logistics are invisible to leaders.

* Drive participants to a filled, ready cohort. Issue invitations, track nominations, confirmations and declines, chase non-responses through executive assistants, and drive required inputs — assessments, pre-work, forms, and closeout surveys — to completion, documenting exceptions.
* Build the repeatable processes behind each program, documented well enough that someone new could run it, and keep program assets current, findable, and reusable cycle over cycle — so delivery never depends on who is staffed.
* Own data capture and standing reporting. Capture data at the right moments in each program and maintain the reporting and quality checks built on it.
* Project-manage design and build work toward execution — workback plans, designer and vendor coordination, decision-gate readiness, and asset production.
* Manage contingent workers and vendors against a clear brief, holding delivery quality and timelines.
* Execute communications plans — drafting, sequencing, scheduling, sending, and tracking.
* Apply AI to how the team operates — automating and compressing internal workflows, reporting, tracking, and production, including completing privacy and sensitivity review.
* Support planning with delivery evidence. Bring participant and program data into quarterly planning, maintain team meeting materials and trackers, and surface delivery risk early.
* Jump in and manage evolving priorities, including planning and executing special projects and events as needed.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years experience developing and executing business and/or learning solutions
* 4+ years of program/project management experience running programs end to end
* Demonstrated track record of delivering high-touch programs or events for senior or executive audiences, where quality and discretion are non-negotiable
* Demonstrated track record of establishing credibility in front of senior leaders — able to hold a room of executives during delivery, read it, and adjust in the moment
* Demonstrated track record of building and maintaining trackers, operating procedures, and reporting that others rely on
* Demonstrated track record of attention to detail in participant-facing materials and communications
* Experience managing complex logistics for in-person and virtual experiences, including vendors and external suppliers
* Experience applying AI tools to automate or improve operational workflows
* Experience managing, structuring, and analyzing program data
* Experience managing contingent workers or vendors to a defined brief
* Entrepreneurial multi-tasker who can be highly efficient with ambiguity and complexity, and who stays calm when timelines compress

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Event management experience at executive level
* Project Management (PMP / PMI) certification
* Experience supporting executive assistants or executive offices
* Data analysis acumen
* Bachelor's Degree

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. GovCIO is seeking a **Senior IT Project Manager** to support mission-critical infrastructure modernization programs for the U.S. Coast Guard (USCG). This position will serve as a key technical leader within the PMO, driving the concurrent execution of complex enterprise network tech refreshes, Out-of-Band (OOB) Management system deployments, and legacy VSAT replacement programs across USCG sites. This position will be a fully remote position.

Responsibilities:

As a Senior IT Project Manager, you will serve as the primary leader responsible for the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of complex IT infrastructure and enterprise network projects to ensure USCG mission success. You will coordinate closely with USCG stakeholders, cross-functional engineering teams, field technicians, and vendor partners to ensure smooth technology upgrades with minimal operational disruption. Key responsibilities include:

* Lead, plan, and execute multiple parallel IT infrastructure projects from initiation through closure, focusing heavily on USCG network hardware refreshes, OOB management deployments, and legacy VSAT transitions.
* Define project scope, build detailed work breakdown structures (WBS), maintain integrated master schedules, and proactively manage critical paths to prevent engineering and deployment bottlenecks.
* Identify, track, and mitigate technical, logistical, and timeline risks early; develop comprehensive contingency plans to minimize network downtime during critical cutovers.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for USCG leadership, technical leads, and third-party vendors, ensuring strict adherence to SLAs, delivery timelines, and military regulations.
* Manage project budgets, track expenditures, forecast financial requirements, and coordinate procurement workflows for global network hardware and connectivity services.
* Coordinate the allocation and daily tasks of network engineers, field technicians, site readiness coordinators, and security teams across various USCG deployment locations.
* Quality-check and oversee the submission of all project deliverables, engineering documentation, change management tickets, and Monthly Status Reports (MSRs).
* Drive operational efficiencies by implementing best practices in IT project management and aligning deployments with USCG and federal architecture standards.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's (or equivalent) with 12+ years of experience.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent federal project management certification.
* Proven experience managing large-scale federal contracts or enterprise IT infrastructure deployments, preferably within the DoD, DHS, or USCG environment.
* Direct IT project management experience deploying Out-of-Band (OOB) Management architectures (e.g., Opengear, Perle, Cradlepoint) for remote network resilience.
* Solid understanding of satellite communications, specifically managing legacy VSAT hardware replacements, link migrations, and troubleshooting circuit transitions.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with experience presenting technical deployment strategies and program status briefings to executive-level government stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Project, Excel (advanced formulas/pivots), and integrated PMO tools for tracking schedules, resource allocation, and performance.

Clearance Level: Must be able to attain and maintain a Public Trust

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Technical certifications (e.g., CCNA, CCNP, ITIL) are a strong plus.
* Direct experience supporting U.S. Coast Guard missions, specifically within C5I or similar technical network directorates.
* Expert proficiency in Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project management frameworks using Jira and Confluence.
* Experience managing complex procurement cycles and vendor contracts for global telecommunications and network equipment.

  
Posted Salary Range: USD $140,000.00 - USD $180,000.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.description:
Case Manager – Social Security Disability Claims

Oct 26, 2026 · @Karl

**Disability Specialists · Cook, MN or remote · $50,000–$60,000 a year**

Why this job matters

Most people who apply for Social Security disability are already going through one of the hardest stretches of their lives. They're out of work, managing a health condition, and facing a federal process with long waits, strict deadlines, and a lot of paperwork. Many are denied the first time and don't realize they can appeal.

That's where we come in. Disability Specialists represents people through SSDI and SSI claims, from the first application through appeal. As our Case Manager, you'll keep each client's claim moving: you'll know where it stands, what it still needs, and what comes next, and you'll make sure the client knows too.

The role

You'll manage a caseload of claims at different stages, working with clients, Social Security field and hearing offices, and medical providers. The job is part paperwork, part detective work, and part customer care. A good day ends with a complete file, a deadline met, and a client who feels less alone in the process.

Your work at each stage of a claim

Stage

What you'll do

**Intake**

Schedule intake appointments and send reminder letters. Handle intakes for new and returning clients when needed, and make first contact with each new client by phone or letter.

**Representation and billing**

Receive and process representation paperwork. Enter charges from the first client conference and from hearings in Prevail, our case management software.

**Working the claim with SSA**

Process paperwork from Social Security and run regular status checks. Keep each client's medical, address, and phone information current, and submit updates when needed. Check claims for quality and accuracy before they go out.

**Denials and appeals**

Process denials at every level, including decisions from Administrative Law Judges and the Appeals Council. Write "good cause" requests when a deadline was missed for a valid reason.

**Hearing level**

Complete pre-hearing forms and review exhibit files. Submit on-the-record requests, dire need requests, and stipulations.

**Appeals Council and federal court**

File Appeals Council appeals and track their status. Set up client calls and appointments when a case moves to the Appeals Council or federal court. When an Appeals Council case ends, close the file and start a new claim if the client needs one.

**Closing files**

Close finished files and withdraw applications or hearing requests when needed. Handle the files of clients who have passed away with care.

**Every day**

* Answer incoming calls from Social Security, hearing offices, and the Appeals Council
* Sort mail, email, and faxes from clients and hearing offices, and route each one to the right person
* Work closely with our representatives and support staff
* Help with other tasks as needed

Who thrives in this role

* **You're organized by nature.** You can keep many open files straight, and you notice when something is missing.
* **You write and speak clearly.** You can explain a confusing letter from Social Security to a worried client, then fill out a precise form for a government reviewer.
* **You stay patient and kind under pressure.** Clients may be in pain, frustrated, or scared. You stay steady and respectful.
* **You follow through.** A records request isn't done when it's sent. It's done when the records arrive.
* **You manage your own time well.** You can plan your day and set priorities without someone checking in, which matters even more if you work remotely.
* **You're comfortable with technology.** You use standard office software easily and can learn a case management system quickly.

**Helpful, but not required:**

* Experience with Prevail case management software
* Knowledge of SSDI and SSI rules and procedures
* A background in social services, healthcare, legal support, insurance claims, or customer service

New to disability claims? If the rest of this sounds like you, we'd still like to hear from you.

Pay and benefits

* **Salary:** $48,000–$60,000, based on experience
* **2 weeks paid vacation** starting your first year
* **24 hours of additional PTO**
* **IRA with [3]% employer match**
* **Health care stipend**
* **Flexibility:** Work from our Cook, MN office or remotely, for qualified candidates
* **Work with a clear purpose:** every finished file moves someone closer to the support they need

Pay: $48,000.00 - $60,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Life insurance
* Paid training

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
The International Research Olympiad (IRO) is a premier global STEM competition that tests science research ability for students aged 13–18. Students from more than 89 countries have taken part, making IRO the largest global community of young students interested in research.

Unlike traditional science olympiads that focus on specific subjects, IRO builds skills useful in any research discipline. Participants deepen their understanding of the scientific process and develop creativity, critical thinking and analysis skills, forming a foundation for later success. IRO is supported by a Board of Advisors and a growing network of partner organizations, including Indigo Research, Punjab Group and Google for Nonprofits, and runs student programs such as IRO Clubs and the IRO Ambassador program.  
  
The IRO Program Manager will be the dedicated full-time owner of IRO’s growth and day-to-day running. You will be accountable for growing registrations and paid participation, building the partnerships, clubs and community that bring students in, and running the competition smoothly as it scales.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. IRO already has a large global audience and an engaged student community; your job is to turn them, together with school and organizational partnerships, into a repeatable growth engine. You will work closely with IRO’s leadership, Board of Advisors, partner organizations, ambassadors and schools, and you are accountable not simply for running the competition, but for growing it.

### **Growth & Partnerships**

* Identify current and future mentor shortages in specific disciplines.
* Lead end-to-end recruitment efforts, including drafting job descriptions, posting roles, proactive sourcing, conducting interviews and sending offers and contracts.
* Provide training and onboarding for mentors to ensure a seamless transition into the program.
* Organize regular quality review meetings with mentors to discuss performance, share best practices, and drive continuous improvement.

### **Competition Operations & In-Person Finals**

* Coordinate the full competition cycle, including registration, online rounds, the in-person Finals, results, awards and certificates
* Keep practice exams, curriculum resources and rules up to date for students and teachers
* Provide clear, timely support to students, parents, teachers and partners throughout the cycle
* Own end-to-end logistics for the in-person IRO Finals, from venue selection and contracting through to event day
* Manage the Finals budget, vendors, catering, AV, signage, printed materials and awards
* Coordinate finalist communications, including invitations, registration, travel and accommodation guidance, visa letters and on-site schedules
* Plan the Finals program, including the exam, presentations, judging, ceremonies and networking, with advisors, judges, partners and volunteers
* Ensure student safety and wellbeing on site, including chaperone requirements, consent forms and emergency procedures
* Build processes and run post-event reviews so IRO and its Finals run smoothly at much higher volume without compromising quality

### **Board of Advisors & Reporting**

* Serve as the main point of contact for IRO’s Board of Advisors, managing communication, onboarding and day-to-day relationships
* Plan and run Board meetings, including scheduling, agendas, briefing materials, minutes and follow-up on action items
* Coordinate Board involvement in the competition, including exam and question review, judging, awards and the Finals
* Recruit and onboard new advisors as IRO grows, keeping Board profiles and public listings up to date
* Keep the Board informed with regular updates on registrations, results, partnerships and key decisions
* Create dashboards and regular reporting on registrations, revenue and partner performance for IRO leadership and the Board
* Track participant data accurately so outcomes, alumni and partner impact can be measured over time

### **Required Skills:**

* 1–3 years of experience in partnerships, program operations, events or growth
* Experience doing outreach to schools, educators or organizations and following through to signed partnerships
* Experience planning and running in-person events, ideally for students or international attendees
* Experience supporting a board, advisory group or senior stakeholders, including meetings and communications
* Experience coordinating multi-stakeholder projects with fixed deadlines
* Background in education, research, STEM, competitions or youth programming is a plus
* Experience in research competitions or olympiads, as a participant or organizer, is a plus

A key part of our model is the integration of deep technical expertise with litigation strategy. Our teams support high-stakes disputes by developing technical narratives, performing rigorous analysis, including reverse engineering and source-code review, and partnering with world-class expert witnesses whose testimony shapes case outcomes in courts and arbitration forums worldwide. Alongside our services business, our iLumos platform delivers expert-guided AI for patent intelligence, moving clients from portfolio analysis to action in minutes rather than months.

Today we work with more than 200 clients worldwide. We have analyzed over 100,000 patents, tested more than 1,200 products, and supported clients in raising over $200M in IP financing, with more than $3.5B tied to verdicts, settlements, and cost savings. That work is delivered by 150 consultants and more than 100 technical experts with exceptional academic backgrounds.

Three Lumenci leaders are named in the IAM Strategy 300: The World's Leading IP Strategists 2026, and Lumenci ranks #14 in Vault's 2026 Top Consulting Asia-Pacific rankings. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we deliver end-to-end support spanning technical analysis, expert strategy, valuation, and monetization execution. We are backed by VSS Capital Partners and Century Equity Partners, and we are growing quickly.

**Employment Type:** Full-time, exempt  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote  
**Location:** US  
**Reports To:** iLumos GTM Leader  
**Travel:** 10–15% (customer meetings, internal sessions, and industry events)

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

iLumos is generating strong inbound interest from law firms, corporate IP teams, and patent investors, and we need someone who can turn that interest into customers. We are looking for an experienced demo professional who can join conversations quickly, show the product's value clearly, and help Sales close deals.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for a professional with 3–5 years of experience who has delivered more than 100 product demos and brings energy, confidence, and presence to every conversation. You will own live demos, discovery, and new customer onboarding, then transition customers to our account team for long-term relationship management.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Product demos and discovery**

* Deliver live, tailored iLumos demos to prospective customers, often on short notice as new leads come in
* Run discovery to understand each prospect's workflows, priorities, and decision criteria
* Show how iLumos solves real patent and IP challenges in terms customers care about
* Adapt each demo to the audience, from patent attorneys and IP counsel to investors and executives

**Objection handling and deal support**

* Answer product, workflow, and value questions confidently during live conversations
* Handle objections and move conversations toward clear next steps
* Partner with Sales to advance opportunities and help close deals
* Support pilot programs by demoing and onboarding pilot users, while Sales owns the pilot
* Share prospect feedback and common objections with the GTM Leader and Product

**Customer onboarding**

* Lead onboarding for new customers so they start using iLumos quickly and confidently
* Walk customers through setup, core workflows, and best practices
* Transition customers smoothly to the account team once onboarding is complete, with a clear handoff of goals, stakeholders, and next steps

**Demo materials**

* Build and refine demo scripts, talk tracks, and objection-handling guides
* Help teammates deliver iLumos demos more consistently

**What You Bring**
------------------

**Required**

* 3–5 years of experience in a customer-facing software role, such as customer success, customer onboarding, pre-sales, solutions consulting, or product specialist
* Has delivered 100+ live product demos to business or professional buyers
* Experience at a patent, IP technology, or legal technology company
* Proven ability to run discovery, handle objections, and move prospects to next steps
* Experience onboarding new customers onto a software product
* Strong presence, energy, and communication skills in live conversations
* Availability to support demos on short notice during business hours
* Ability to travel 10–15% for customer meetings, internal sessions, and industry events

**Preferred**

* Experience demoing AI, analytics, or data-driven products
* Familiarity with patent and IP workflows, such as prior art search, patent landscaping, portfolio analysis, or litigation support
* Technical, engineering, or legal background, such as a patent agent, engineering degree, or JD
* Experience with Salesforce or HubSpot

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

**First 30 days:** Learn the iLumos product, customers, and core patent and IP workflows. Shadow demos and begin delivering them with support.

**First 60 days:** Deliver demos on your own and cover incoming demo requests promptly. Lead onboarding for new customers.

**First 90 days:** Consistently move demos to clear next steps with Sales. Onboard new customers and hand them off smoothly to Sales Enablement. Deliver a reusable demo script and objection-handling guide.

**Why You Will Love Working for Lumenci**

Dynatron is transforming the automotive service industry with intelligent SaaS solutions that deliver measurable results for thousands of dealership service departments. Our proprietary analytics, automation, and AI-powered workflows help service leaders increase profitability, elevate customer satisfaction, and operate with greater efficiency.  
  
With accelerating demand and an expanding product ecosystem, we’re scaling quickly. Building a predictable, efficient revenue engine is critical to our next stage of growth.

jobs.description:
**Clinical Product Operations Specialist**
==========================================

**Hello Alpha** | Full-time | Remote | Reports to the Chief Medical Officer

**About Hello Alpha**
---------------------

Hello Alpha is a telemedicine company. Our team of engineers, clinicians and operators builds the web platform that patients, care teams and partner organizations use every day.  
  
**Alpha Values:**

* **We are mission-driven -** We’re changing the paradigm of healthcare for patients who are historically underrepresented due to sex, race, gender, language, economic status, location, disability, and other diverse backgrounds. We empower our Primary Care Providers with a foundation in women’s health to administer patient-centered care throughout a woman’s lifespan.
* **We put patients first -** We prioritize what’s best for our patients, not what’s easier or more profitable. We do whatever it takes to provide excellent care and empower patients to take control of their health.
* **One team, One Dream -** We work together as a team to bring to life our vision of a more just healthcare system. We trust each other, communicate openly and honestly. We give credit where it is due, provide opportunities for employee growth and development, assume good intentions, and celebrate our wins as a team.
* **Diversity is at our core -** Alpha exists to bring a more accessible, equitable system to care for the whole woman regardless of age, income, and location. We are inclusive, welcoming, and value different perspectives.
* **We are data-driven -** Alphanauts love data and value facts over opinions. We use evidence-based science to highlight the clinical value of our mission.
* **We are proactive and positive -** Alphanauts learn by doing and address challenges without waiting or worrying about their scope. We are pragmatic and value progress over perfection. We are optimistic and believe in the power of positivity.

**About the role**
------------------

We are hiring a Clinical Product Operations Specialist to be the connective tissue between product, engineering, our care team and our partners. You will own three things end to end: the content that powers our patient-facing experience in Contentful, the data requests that keep the business informed in Amazon QuickSight, and the bug triage process that keeps our platform reliable. You will also write the standard operating procedures (SOPs) that make our work repeatable, act as the product expert for our clinical team, and help shape how we plan, ship and communicate releases.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Manage content in Contentful**

* Create, review and publish content entries, and keep a calendar of scheduled changes.
* Run a QA pass in our staging environment before anything patient-facing goes live.
* Keep content structure, naming and permissions consistent, and archive what is outdated.
* Write clear requests to engineering when a content type needs to change, and verify the result.

**Own data requests and reporting in QuickSight**

* Run a single intake process for data requests so every ask has an owner, a purpose and a deadline.
* Build and maintain QuickSight dashboards, and turn recurring requests into self-serve reports.
* Write SQL for ad hoc analysis and define key metrics so numbers match across reports.
* Check reports against underlying data before they go to partners, finance or leadership.
* Handle patient data responsibly by pulling only what each request needs.

**Run bug tracking and triage**

* Collect bug reports from our care team, support and partners, and link duplicates.
* Reproduce issues in staging and write up clear recaps with steps, expected and actual behavior, and screenshots.
* Lead a weekly bug review, verify fixes before closing, and update the person who reported each issue.

**Be the product expert for our clinical team**

* Know the patient dashboard and the care-team dashboard well enough to answer "how does this work?" from clinicians and clinical operations.
* Be the first point of contact for clinician questions and workflow issues; resolve what you can and escalate the rest.
* Be the owner of EMR (e.g., Athena) and resolve integration issues with EMR tech support
* Translate clinical workflow needs into clear, well-scoped requests for product and engineering.
* Walk clinicians through new features and changes, and bring their feedback back to the product team.
* Keep clinician-facing guides and training material accurate as the product changes.

**Keep product operations running**

* Coordinate releases: draft release clinical SOPs, write and maintain SOPs for recurring work across product, clinical and operations teams, such as content QA, data requests, bug triage and release checks.
* Support partner onboarding with checklists, test accounts and user acceptance testing.
* Send a regular update on content, data and bug queues, and keep the Jira backlog organized for clinical/operations requests

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 2-4 years in product operations, business operations, analytics or a similar role, ideally in health tech or healthcare.
* Strong SQL and hands-on experience with a BI tool such as QuickSight, Tableau or Looker.
* Experience managing content in a headless CMS, ideally Contentful.
* Experience managing EMR workflows, ideally Athena.
* Experience triaging and documenting bugs in Jira.
* Clear, concise writing: tickets, SOPs and updates that others can act on without a meeting.
* Ability to explain a technical product to non-technical clinical colleagues, and to turn their needs into clear requests for engineers.
* A careful, organized approach, and comfort working with sensitive health data under HIPAA.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Content modeling experience in Contentful.
* Experience writing SOPs or training material in a clinical or regulated environment.
* Familiarity with Amazon Redshift and dbt.
* Background in telemedicine, pha

jobs.description:
Who We Are

**Our mission is simple but critical: to build pathways for adult learners to earn high-quality, workforce-aligned degrees and credentials from North Carolina’s public universities.**

**At Project Kitty Hawk, our work reflects our company values:**

**Collaboration** – We prioritize our partners’ success and reputation, aligning every initiative with their goals, reflecting their values, and enhancing their impact.

**Innovation** – We innovate, not replicate. As creative problem solvers, we use data-driven insights to push boundaries, continuously improve our services, develop solutions, and redefine what it means to serve nontraditional learners.

**Empathy** – We understand the unique challenges of nontraditional learners, and are committed to supporting them with empathy, respect, and solutions that fit their needs.

**Integrity** – We operate with transparency and accountability in everything we do. We uphold honesty, take ownership of our work, and maintain the highest standards.

**Teamwork** – We embody the collaboration we seek. We always strive to be dependable, supportive, and solutions-oriented teammates.

Together, we partner with universities in the University of North Carolina (UNC) System to produce innovative, flexible degree and credential programs in high-demand fields. Each PKH team member plays a vital role in advancing this mission and shaping the future of education for adult learners.

These values will enable us to realize PKH’s vision: to make North Carolina’s public universities the top choice for adult learners and to amplify the UNC System’s role as a national leader in higher education innovation, access, and student success. By joining our team, you have an opportunity to contribute to our achievement of that vision, in the process helping to create opportunities for thousands of learners to earn their success and move up the economic ladder.

At Project Kitty Hawk we hire talented people who are not only dedicated to our mission but share our belief that working together makes us stronger and more effective. In this organization you’ll find individuals with a range of interesting backgrounds and life stories; the true magic happens when those individuals come together to solve problems in service of a common goal.

### **The Role**

The Re-Enrollment Specialist (RES) is the primary point of contact for students who have stopped out before completing a degree and want to complete their degree at a UNC System institution. The RES leads the outreach to students, including calling contacts and prioritized segments, understanding the challenges students encountered before stopping out and what stands in the way of returning, and guiding them to the right readmission pathway at the appropriate UNC System institution.

### **What you'll do:**

* Execute high-volume outbound contact (call, text, email) to stopped-out students, prioritizing campaign responders and assigned segments in alignment with established cadences and content guidelines.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand each student’s reasons for stopping out, current goals, and barriers to return.
* Guide students through their next step, from selecting a pathway to starting the readmission or re-entry application, and confirm a warm handoff to the appropriate campus contact.
* Manage a personal pipeline in the CRM (Education Cloud), maintaining accurate dispositions, campus of origin and destination, and next actions.
* Monitor individual metrics, including contact rate, conversations, application starts, and campus handoffs, and take corrective action to improve results.
* Conduct long-term nurturing follow-up to student completers to gather information on student experience, success, and retention
* Develop and maintain working knowledge of the readmission policies, processes, and deadlines of each participating UNC System institution, including readmission versus new-application rules, time-away thresholds, academic standing and suspension requirements, holds, and transfer-credit considerations.
* Use the Re-Enrollment campus knowledge base to identify the correct pathway for each student’s situation and set accurate expectations about requirements and timelines.
* Apply System and campus operating rules on where a student may return (e.g., home-campus-first) and escalate exceptions or unclear cases to the REM.
* Capture structured, consistent data on stop-out reasons, barriers, and outcomes so the program can segment, prioritize, and report accurately.
* Share regular feedback with the REM on messaging performance, list and data quality, and recurring student objections to inform campaign and cadence adjustments.
* Flag policy changes, process friction, and discrepancies between published campus policy and student experience, and contribute updates to the knowledge base and team playbooks.
* Close the loop with campus partners on handoffs, confirming receipt and tracking returned outcomes to identify where students stall after reconnection.
* Partner with the REM and campus re-enrollment, registrar, and admissions contacts to resolve student questions and smooth the path back.
* Collaborate with PKH Marketing, Operations, and Analytics teams on campaign timing, list updates, and reporting.
* Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all student records and CRM data in the RES’s personal pipeline.

### **What you bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* 1+ years of experience in higher education admissions, advising, re-enrollment, or student recruitment, OR equivalent experience in high-volume outbound outreach or customer success.
* Preferred: Experience with readmission or registrar processes, adult and “some college, no credential” learners, or the UNC System.
* Comfort and consistency with high-volume outbound calling, including persistence and resilience with cold and re-engagement outreach.
* Ability to learn, compare, and accurately apply differing policies

jobs.title: Sr. Enablement Partner
jobs.description:
**About us**  
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.  
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.  
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.  
  
**Our people**  
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.  
  
**Our impact**  
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.  
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts  

**Who You Are**  
You are an experienced enablement professional who knows how to turn performance challenges into practical training, coaching, and development programs. You understand the customer lifecycle and how effective customer conversations contribute to retention, winback, and account growth.

You are a builder and a coach who enjoys developing programs, creating practical resources, and helping customer-facing teams improve their performance. You can independently manage assigned enablement initiatives, analyze performance trends, and work closely with frontline leaders to identify opportunities for improvement.

You bring strong facilitation, instructional design, and communication skills, along with the ability to translate business priorities into learning experiences that drive measurable improvements.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

HighLevel's Customer Retention and Account Management teams play a critical role in helping customers realize value, maintain their subscriptions, and grow their businesses through the platform.

As a Senior Enablement Partner, you will develop and deliver training, coaching, and learning resources that strengthen customer engagement, retention, winback, and account expansion. You'll work closely with frontline leadership to identify performance gaps, build practical solutions, and reinforce the skills and behaviors that contribute to improved business outcomes.

**You will:**

* Independently manage assigned enablement initiatives, from identifying business and performance needs through program design, implementation, and evaluation, in alignment with the revenue enablement strategy and organizational priorities.
* Leverage AI-powered tools to develop training content, create realistic practice scenarios, support coaching, and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of enablement programs.
